paragraphs.text: Severo Jr. was a vengeful human man in New Capenna , whose own schemes led to his demise.

Severo was a vengeful and calculating antagonist who had a personal vendetta against Anhelo . He was characterized by his deep-seated grudge and meticulous planning. Severo's appearance was notable for a facial scar, particularly a broken nose that gave him a distinctive, hardened look. His demeanor reflected a blend of confidence and malice, with an underlying intensity that suggested a history of conflict and pain. He was skilled at deception, adeptly disguising his true identity as "Antonio Swift" to infiltrate and enact his revenge.

Severo, disguised as Antonio Swift, tricked Anhelo into taking a cab ride. Using this disguise, he managed to lure Anhelo into a situation where he could exact his revenge. Severo's disguise and the setup of the luxurious cab were part of a calculated plan to catch Anhelo off guard.

During the cab ride, Severo reveals his true identity and his motive for revenge. He accused Anhelo of killing his father, Severo Sr., on his birthday three years prior. Severo’s plan involved crashing the cab into a Riveteer transport, causing a violent confrontation and ensuring Anhelo's suffering. Angelo reached out and stabbed Severo in the chest with his dagger, but could not avert the cab flying off the road.

The crash and ensuing chaos were part of Severo's scheme to disrupt Anhelo's plans for the day. Severo laughed maniacally even while dying, leaving Anhelo severely injured and surrounded by Riveteers. The Riveteers were initially intent on retrieving stolen Halo from the car, but Severo's interference left Anhelo in a desperate fight for survival. Only Toluz 's timely intervention stopped Anhelo from being killed by the Riveteers, ultimately foiling Severo's plans.
